title: REMOVE CLIPS / REMOVE WINDSHIELD GLASS / INSPECTION AND CLEANING

content.description: Illustration showing a clip and fastener assembly used to secure windshield trim

content.text: Be careful not to damage the clips when removing them around the glass.
Do not remove fasteners. If any fastener is deformed, replace it.

items: (a) Push piano wire through from the interior.
(b) Tie both wire ends to a wooden block or equivalent.

content.description: Illustration showing piano wire being inserted through windshield glass seal from interior

content.text: When separating, take care not to damage the paint and interior and exterior ornaments. To prevent scratching the safety pad when removing the windshield, place a plastic sheet between the piano wire and safety pad.

items: (c) Cut the adhesive by pulling the piano wire around it.

content.description: Illustration showing hands pulling piano wire around windshield to cut adhesive

content.text: Cut off the glass, leaving as much of the urethane layer on the body as possible.
(a) Remove any dam remaining on the body.
Leave as much urethane layer on the body as possible.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of adhesive dam from body surface using scraper

content.text: (b) Clean the cutting surface of the urethane gum with a piece of cloth saturated in solvent (alcohol).

content.description: Illustration showing cleaning of urethane gum with alcohol-saturated cloth
